wir-sind-nicht-mehr-stumm.name: Wir sind nicht mehr stumm (We are no longer silent)
wir-sind-nicht-mehr-stumm.teaser: Long-term effects (Folgestörungen) of abuse and other harmful experiences
wir-sind-nicht-mehr-stumm.beschreibung:
Violence and abuse – whether physical, psychological, sexual or digital – and other harmful experiences do not always end with the event itself. Many people affected live with emotional or physical after-effects long afterwards – often accompanied by shame, guilt and the feeling that these burdens are not properly seen or understood.

Our self-help group ‘Wir sind nicht mehr stumm’ is about being allowed to talk about exactly that. We want to share experiences, strengthen one another and make it visible that long-term effects must be taken seriously and understood as part of the violence experienced.

The group is only for people who have been affected themselves and is a space for sharing experiences as equals. Nobody has to say more than feels right at the moment – just listening is completely fine too.
wir-sind-nicht-mehr-stumm.schlusssatz: Together, we want to break the silence – because we are silent no more.

buerokratie-labyrinth.name: Bürokratie-Labyrinth (Bureaucracy Labyrinth)
buerokratie-labyrinth.teaser: Trapped in a jungle of authorities, applications and procedures
buerokratie-labyrinth.beschreibung:
Applications, deadlines, long processing times and letters that are hard to understand can quickly become overwhelming – especially when you already need a lot of strength for other things.

In our self-help group ‘Bürokratie-Labyrinth – Gefangen im Dschungel der Behörden’ (Bureaucracy Labyrinth – Trapped in the Jungle of Authorities), we share experiences of authorities, public offices, applications and procedures. We talk about what has helped and which routes are possible, and we support each other in sorting paperwork, filling in forms and writing letters and emails.

The group is for people affected and their family members. It does not offer legal advice and is not an information event – it lives from sharing experiences with one another.
buerokratie-labyrinth.schlusssatz: Together, we find ways through the bureaucracy labyrinth – step by step.

seelenfarben.name: Seelenfarben (Colours of the Soul)
seelenfarben.teaser: When pictures say more than 1,000 words
seelenfarben.beschreibung:
Sometimes it is easier to paint something than to say it out loud. ‘Seelenfarben’ is about letting feelings, thoughts and inner processes become visible through creativity – with no pressure to perform and no judgement.

We paint together, on open or set themes. Afterwards, anyone who wants to can show their picture and talk about what emerged. Nobody has to explain or speak – simply being there to paint is completely fine too.

The group is for people living with mental health difficulties, experiences of trauma or chronic illness, as well as family members and anyone interested. The focus is on creative expression, relief, sharing and building inner strength.
seelenfarben.schlusssatz: What is hard to put into words can become visible here through colour.

skillin-me-softly.name: Skillin me Softly
skillin-me-softly.beschreibung:
Sometimes all it takes is a smell, a sentence, a situation or a memory – and suddenly the tension is there. What helps in moments like these differs from person to person.

In ‘Skillin me Softly – Triggers and Skills’, we share what triggers us and what helps when tension runs high. Which skills work? What have others tried? And what might be helpful for you, too?

It is not about finding the one right solution, but about sharing experiences, learning from each other and discovering new possibilities. You can talk, ask questions, listen or simply be there.

The group is only for people who have been affected themselves.
skillin-me-softly.schlusssatz: Sometimes the tension comes faster than words can explain – here, you can simply be with it.

schreibwerkstatt.name: Zwischen den Zeilen (Between the Lines)
schreibwerkstatt.beschreibung:
Thoughts, feelings and experiences are not always easy to say out loud – on paper, they often find another way. ‘Zwischen den Zeilen’ aims to create space for putting into words whatever is there right now.

This is not about being able to write ‘well’. It is about sorting your thoughts, putting feelings into words and giving space to what might otherwise remain unsaid.

Texts can be shared – but they do not have to be. You decide for yourself what you want to write, show or keep to yourself.

The writing workshop is meant to be open to everyone and is currently still being prepared.
schreibwerkstatt.schlusssatz: The most important things are not always found in big words – but often between the lines.

ag-01-ser.name: SER (OEG/SGB XIV) vs. best practice and worst case
ag-01-ser.teaser: How do people affected really experience social compensation law (Soziales Entschädigungsrecht)?
ag-01-ser.beschreibung:
In this working group, we look at experiences from proceedings under the Crime Victims Compensation Act (Opferentschädigungsgesetz, OEG) and Book XIV of the Social Code (Sozialgesetzbuch XIV, SGB XIV) – at what works well, but also at obstacles, burdens and recurring problems.

To do this, we analyse anonymised experiences and case files from different federal states. In this way, we want to show where good practice works and where people affected keep coming up against similar limits.

Our aim is to build a bigger picture from individual experiences – so that grievances do not disappear as isolated cases and good solutions become visible where they already work.

You can join at any time, whether you bring knowledge, experience, creativity or the wish to change something.

Interested? Just send us a short message: arbeitsgruppe@kein-einzelfall.de
ag-01-ser.schlusssatz: We make visible what would otherwise disappear into individual files.

ag-02-ifg.name: IFG vs. open questions about the SER
ag-02-ifg.teaser: We ask because we want to understand.
ag-02-ifg.beschreibung:
In social compensation law (Soziales Entschädigungsrecht, SER), many questions remain unanswered for people affected. Processes are hard to follow, information is missing or inconsistent – and it is often unclear why decisions are made the way they are.

In this working group, we collect exactly these open questions and bring them together in a structured way. Through requests under the Freedom of Information Act (Informationsfreiheitsgesetz, IFG), we want to get answers, better understand how things fit together and show how the SER is applied in practice.

From the answers, we want to work out where good solutions already work and where procedures are particularly stressful or problematic for people affected. Step by step, this should make best practice and worst case visible.

You can take part with your own questions or experiences, or by helping with research, structuring and analysis.

You can join at any time, whether you bring knowledge, experience, creativity or the wish to change something.

Interested? Just send us a short message: arbeitsgruppe@kein-einzelfall.de
ag-02-ifg.schlusssatz: We ask questions because understanding is the first step towards recognising differences and making change possible.

ag-03-online-veranstaltungen.name: Event planning
ag-03-online-veranstaltungen.teaser: An idea becomes a date – and a date becomes a space for exchange, knowledge and meeting others.
ag-03-online-veranstaltungen.beschreibung:
In this working group, we plan and develop the events of KE!N EINZELFALL. Together, we gather topics, think about suitable formats, look for speakers and take care of the many small steps that turn an idea into a good event.

Whether it is a talk, workshop, discussion group, information evening or a new participation format – this is a place to think along, organise and try things out. It is not just about how things run, but also about designing events so that they are understandable, accessible and as comfortable as possible for those taking part.

You can contribute ideas, organisational skills, research, technical know-how, facilitation or simply your interest.

You can join at any time, whether you bring knowledge, experience, creativity or the wish to change something.

Interested? Just send us a short message: arbeitsgruppe@kein-einzelfall.de
ag-03-online-veranstaltungen.schlusssatz: Good events do not just happen – they grow out of many ideas, perspectives and people who make them possible together.

ag-04-soziale-medien.name: Social media
ag-04-soziale-medien.teaser: Visibility does not happen on its own.
ag-04-soziale-medien.beschreibung:
In this working group, we develop the content for our social media channels together. We think about which topics matter, how to present them clearly and how we can make visible the perspectives of people affected, knowledge, the association’s work and current developments.

This results in posts, reels, stories and new formats on topics such as trauma, self-help, social compensation law (Soziales Entschädigungsrecht), long-term care (Pflege), degree of disability (Grad der Behinderung, GdB), events, association news and ‘Deine Stimme’ (Your Voice).

You can contribute ideas, writing, design, research, video, planning or simply your own view on a topic.

You can join at any time, whether you bring knowledge, experience, creativity or the wish to change something.

Interested? Just send us a short message: arbeitsgruppe@kein-einzelfall.de
ag-04-soziale-medien.schlusssatz: Because visibility begins where experiences, knowledge and voices are given their place.

ag-05-oeffentlichkeitsarbeit.name: Public relations
ag-05-oeffentlichkeitsarbeit.teaser: So that people can see what we stand for and what we set in motion.
ag-05-oeffentlichkeitsarbeit.beschreibung:
In this working group, we look at how KE!N EINZELFALL presents itself and reaches people. We develop ideas for information materials, appearances at fairs, campaigns and other forms of public presence.

This includes, for example, flyers, roll-up banners, business cards, information stands and preparing for volunteering fairs or other events. Together, we think about how to communicate our topics in a way that is clear, accessible and recognisable.

You can join at any time. You can contribute design, writing, organisation, planning, research or your own ideas.

Interested? Just send us a short message: arbeitsgruppe@kein-einzelfall.de
ag-05-oeffentlichkeitsarbeit.schlusssatz: For us, public relations means making visible what matters – and getting people talking to each other.

ag-06-datenbanken.name: Databases
ag-06-datenbanken.teaser: Knowledge only helps if you can actually find it.
ag-06-datenbanken.beschreibung:
In this working group, we collect, sort and structure information that may be important for people affected, family members, anyone interested and professionals. Our aim is not to let knowledge disappear somewhere, but to prepare it so that it can later be found and used in a targeted way.

Step by step, this creates databases on different topics – for example with full-text court rulings, networks, specialist literature or other helpful information. Together, we consider which content is genuinely useful, how it can be sensibly organised and how it can become a reliable collection of knowledge.

You can join at any time. You can contribute research, sorting, structuring, data entry or your own ideas.

Interested? Just send us a short message: arbeitsgruppe@kein-einzelfall.de
ag-06-datenbanken.schlusssatz: Many separate pieces of information can add up to a sense of direction.

ag-07-glaubhaftigkeitsgutachten.name: Credibility assessments (Glaubhaftigkeitsgutachten)
ag-07-glaubhaftigkeitsgutachten.teaser: When memories are assessed, it takes knowledge, care and a close look.
ag-07-glaubhaftigkeitsgutachten.beschreibung:
In this working group, we look at credibility assessments in proceedings under the Crime Victims Compensation Act (Opferentschädigungsgesetz, OEG) and Book XIV of the Social Code (Sozialgesetzbuch XIV, SGB XIV). We examine the criteria by which statements are assessed, what role issues such as memory, suggestion, dissociation or the after-effects of trauma (Traumafolgen) play, and where problems keep arising from the perspective of people affected.

We want to bring together expert reports, scientific foundations, court decisions and experiences from proceedings and put them into context in an understandable way. We are particularly interested in how rigorously the work is done, where the limits of such assessments lie and which aspects may not be given enough consideration when complex after-effects of trauma are involved.

The aim is to pool knowledge, make differences visible and give people affected better orientation in an area that is often hard to understand and very distressing.

You can join at any time. You can take part with your own experience, specialist knowledge, research or by helping to analyse and structure materials.

Interested? Just send us a short message: arbeitsgruppe@kein-einzelfall.de
ag-07-glaubhaftigkeitsgutachten.schlusssatz: Where credibility is being decided, accuracy must not be a side issue.

ag-08-app.name: Developing an app
ag-08-app.teaser: When support is needed, it should be as quick to reach as possible.
ag-08-app.beschreibung:
In this working group, we are developing the idea for an app that is meant to give people orientation and support in everyday life. We think about which features are really helpful, which information needs to be quickly accessible and how the app can be built to be as simple, clear and easy to access as possible.

The focus is on the experiences of the people who will later use the app. That is why we gather ideas, look at needs, develop content and think together about how many individual requirements can become an app that helps at the right moment.

You can join at any time. You can take part with your own experience, ideas, research, technical knowledge, design or by testing new features.

Interested? Just send us a short message: arbeitsgruppe@kein-einzelfall.de
ag-08-app.schlusssatz: A good idea becomes valuable when it can give people orientation at the right moment.
